business.what_it_does: Defence electronics supplier to government buyers: air-defence systems (QRSAM, an expected INR30,000 crore order) and weapons, sensor and navigation subsystems for naval programmes such as the Next Generation Corvette. In at least one large programme about 70% of the order value is passed to 200+ MSME partners. Order book was INR68,717 crore on 1 Oct 2026, 2.3x TTM revenue of INR30,253 crore.

segments.name: Air defence (QRSAM)
segments.comment: About INR30,000 crore order still expected but delayed since at least Q1 FY27; management expects no price escalation (C4, C5, C9).

segments.name: Naval systems (NGC weapons, sensors, navigation)
segments.comment: Shipyard contracts signed; about INR20,000 crore of BEL orders expected in FY27 in a staggered way (G6, C3).

segments.name: Exports
segments.comment: Revenue share not stated; target is 10% of revenue within five years and about USD300 million of export orders in FY27 (G15, G14).

credibility.label: medium
credibility.summary: Financial guidance is set low and beaten: FY26 revenue grew 16.2% against a 15% guide and margin was 29.2% against a 27% floor, and H1 FY27 revenue is up 25.8% against 15%. Order-inflow guidance is the reverse: it was cut from INR55,000+ crore to INR50,000+ crore with only INR7,334 crore booked by 1 Oct as QRSAM keeps slipping, and the Q1 FY27 closing remarks gave contradictory numbers (21-23% margin, INR20,000 crore inflow).

promises.evidence: H1 FY27 revenue up 25.8% YoY (management: 25.97%, INR12,824 crore vs INR10,180 crore) against a 15%+ guide. A full-year 15% needs only about 8.6% growth in H2, so the guide is a floor, not a forecast.

Computed H1 FY27 EBITDA margin is 26.6% (Q1 25.0%, Q2 27.9%); management's own H1 figure is 27.43% (C2), so the definitions differ. Getting to 28% for the year needs about 29% in H2, which means repeating H2 FY26's 29.7%/29.2%. Q2 was 150 bps below Q2 FY26.
Same 28% FY27 target. H1 is at 26.6% on the computed basis. H1 PBT grew 14.66% against revenue growth of 25.97% (C2), which confirms the margin dilution.
H1 FY27 revenue up 25.8% against a 15% guide. The guide has been held at 15% across three calls (Q4 FY26, Q1, Q2) even as actual growth ran 24.9% and 26.5% in Q1 and Q2.

Only INR7,334 crore booked up to 1 Oct (C2): 15% of the INR50,000+ crore including-QRSAM guide and 29% of the INR25,000 crore ex-QRSAM floor. Hitting INR50,000 crore needs about INR42,700 crore in H2, which depends on QRSAM (about INR30,000 crore, delayed, C4/C5) and NGC (about INR20,000 crore, G6) both landing before March.
promises.actual: INR7,334 crore ordered in FY27 up to 1 Oct 2026

promises.evidence: The INR1,200 crore FY27 capex guide has been held across three calls (G28, G12, G5), but the inputs contain no capex figure to check it against.
H1 FY27 revenue growth of 25.8% is running well above the 'more than 15%' guide given in Q4 FY26.
The Q4 FY26 version said 'more than 28%'. In the two later calls it was softened to 'around 28%' / 'maintain 28%' (G8, G2), while H1 came in at 26.6% computed (27.43% management basis).
FY26 revenue grew 16.2% against a 'more than 15%' guide given in Q3 FY26: a narrow beat.
FY26 EBITDA margin was 29.2%, 220 bps above the 27% floor management 'assured' in Q3 FY26.
The INR2,200+ crore FY27 R&D target was repeated from Q1 FY27 (G13). The inputs contain no R&D spend figure.

NGC shipyard contracts were signed the day before the Q2 call, and the programme size rose from about INR38,000 crore to INR53,000 crore (C3). Subsystem awards to BEL have not been placed yet, and their timing and route (nomination or competitive) are unconfirmed.
The INR55,000+ crore including-QRSAM target from Q1 FY27 was restated in Q2 FY27 as INR50,000+ crore including QRSAM (G3), a cut of at least INR5,000 crore. Only INR7,334 crore was booked by 1 Oct.
promises.actual: Guide cut to INR50,000+ crore; INR7,334 crore booked by 1 Oct 2026

promises.evidence: Capex 'INR1,200 plus crore' was restated as 'around INR1,200 crore' in Q2 (G5). The inputs contain no capex figure.

The code check marks this on_track, but the 21-23% band contradicts the 28% margin given in the same call (G8) and is beaten by H1's 26.6%. It looks like a misstatement in the closing remarks, not real guidance, and should be disregarded.
The R&D budget of more than INR2,200 crore was reiterated in Q2 (G4). The inputs contain no R&D spend figure.
Internal export-order target of about USD300 million for FY27. The inputs give no export order inflow figure and no update on it in Q2.

The 'more than INR55,000 crore' FY27 inflow guide from Q4 FY26 was held in Q1 FY27 (G7) and then lowered to INR50,000+ crore including QRSAM in Q2 FY27 (G3). QRSAM delay is the stated reason (C4, C7).

promises.evidence: The 'more than INR1,200 crore' FY27 capex target was held through Q2 FY27 (G5). The inputs contain no capex number.
The inputs contain no FY26 order inflow figure to test the INR27,000 crore target against.

The 'more than INR20,000 crore including QRSAM' closing-remark figure contradicts the INR55,000+ crore guide given in the same call (G7), so it cannot be read as guidance. At face value, INR7,334 crore (37%) was booked by 1 Oct.
The inputs contain no FY26 capex figure.
Five-year target for exports to reach 10% of revenue. The current export share of revenue is not in the inputs.
Target of employee cost at about 12% of turnover 'in coming years'. The inputs contain no employee cost data.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: FY27 revenue growth of 15%+, held unchanged across Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 (G25, G9, G1).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Revenue grew 24.9% and 26.5% YoY in Q1 and Q2, 25.8% for H1. Management says it has pulled deliveries forward to avoid a Q4-loaded year (C6), so H2 needs only about 8.6% growth to meet the guide.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: EBITDA margin around 28% for FY27 (G2, G8), softened from 'more than 28%' in Q4 FY26 (G26).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q2 margin was 27.9% against 29.4% a year earlier, and H1 was 26.6% computed (27.43% per management). H1 PAT grew 14.8% against revenue growth of 26%, so faster execution is diluting margins.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management is 'not alarmed by the delays' and still expects INR50,000+ crore of FY27 orders including QRSAM (C7, G3).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: INR7,334 crore was booked in H1, against INR12,824 crore of H1 revenue: a book-to-bill of about 0.57. The target has already been cut from INR55,000+ crore (G27, G7), and QRSAM has been described as delayed since Q1 FY27 (C9).

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Order delays will not hit execution because of advance action and MSME supply-chain investment (C7, C8).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Cash-conversion cycle lengthened from 261 to 342 days over three years and 5-year CFO/PAT is 0.59, consistent with working capital tied up ahead of billing. Whether the advance action converts to revenue is too early to tell.

bull.point: Revenue is compounding ahead of guidance: up 25.8% in H1 FY27 against a 15% guide, after 16.2% in FY26 against 15%. TTM revenue is INR30,253 crore.

Visibility: the INR68,717 crore order book covers 2.3x TTM revenue before QRSAM (about INR30,000 crore, C5) and NGC (about INR20,000 crore, G6) are added; the NGC shipyard contracts are already signed (C3).
Balance sheet and returns: net cash with debt/equity of 0.0 and INR85 crore of borrowings, ROCE 36%, 5-year FCF INR8,376 crore, and margin up 610 bps over three years.

bear.point: Order inflow is behind: INR7,334 crore booked by 1 Oct against a FY27 guide already cut from INR55,000+ crore to INR50,000+ crore. Hitting it needs about INR42,700 crore in H2, and QRSAM has slipped for two quarters.

Margin slippage: Q2 margin was 27.9% against 29.4% a year earlier, and H1 PBT grew 14.66% against revenue growth of 25.97%. QRSAM is priced at a figure first quoted more than a year ago with no escalation expected (C4, C5), so cost inflation falls on BEL.
Cash conversion is weak: the cash-conversion cycle stretched from 261 to 342 days in three years, and 5-year CFO/PAT is 0.59, so reported profit is not turning into cash at the same rate.

questions: With INR7,334 crore booked by 1 Oct, how much of the INR50,000+ crore FY27 inflow guide is QRSAM and NGC? If QRSAM slips past March, what is the realistic ex-QRSAM number, and is the INR25,000 crore floor safe?

A 15% full-year guide implies only about 8.6% H2 revenue growth after 25.8% in H1. Is H2 genuinely weaker because deliveries were pulled forward (C6), or is the guide conservative? And what H2 EBITDA margin are you assuming to reach 28% from 26.6% in H1?

The cash-conversion cycle went from 261 to 342 days and 5-year CFO/PAT is 0.59. How much of this is advance inventory for QRSAM and similar programmes (C7) versus delayed customer payments, and when does it reverse?
